arguments.sql:
SELECT
    f."NSLP Provision Status" AS provision_status,
    s.Magnet AS magnet,
    COUNT(*) AS joined_rows,
    COUNT(s.City) AS nonnull_cities,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.City = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS empty_cities
FROM main.frpm AS f
JOIN main.schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
GROUP BY f."NSLP Provision Status", s.Magnet
ORDER BY provision_status, magnet

SELECT
    s.City AS city,
    COUNT(*) AS magnet_school_count
FROM main.schools AS s
JOIN main.frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" IN (
      'Provision 2',
      'Breakfast Provision 2',
      'Lunch Provision 2'
  )
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY magnet_school_count DESC, city
LIMIT -1
